basic_details.job_title: BEL Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad, a Navaratna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, offers a one-year apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (Amended) at a monthly stipend of INR 17,500 for B.Tech graduates who passed on or after 14/11/2023. There are 15 Graduate Apprentice places for 2026-27: Civil Engineering 2, Mechanical Engineering 3 and Electronics 10. Maximum age is 25 years as on 15/11/2026. Apply on the web portal nats.education.gov.in from 15 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum age should not be more than 25 years as on 15/11/2026. Upper age relaxation applies as below. | Category Relaxation SC / ST 5 years OBC 3 years PwBD 10 years

content_sections.heading: BEL Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Bharat Electronics Limited (A Government of India Enterprise), Ghaziabad
Graduate Apprentice (Civil Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Electronics)

content_sections.heading: About the Employer
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad is a Navaratna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Its notice carries the address Bharat Nagar Post, Ghaziabad (U.P.) 201010. This is an apprenticeship, not a regular job.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice proposes 15 apprentices for 2026-27. The numbers are indicative and may be changed by the Management without any further notification. Reservation for SC/ST/PWD/OBC/EWS candidates will be as per Government guidelines. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

rows.field_trade: Electronics (Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The same qualification and age limit apply to all three fields. Maximum age should not be more than 25 years as on 15/11/2026. Upper age relaxation applies as below. Candidates should not have completed, or be undergoing, apprenticeship training in another organization. Those who have already completed their apprenticeship, terminated it mid-way, or are pursuing it with other organizations are not eligible.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech in Civil Engineering, recognized by AICTE or GOI, passed on or after 14/11/2023
B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, recognized by AICTE or GOI, passed on or after 14/11/2023

rows.post_field: Electronics (Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering)
rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech in the above mentioned branches, recognized by AICTE or GOI, passed on or after 14/11/2023

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship lasts one year. The monthly stipend is INR 17,500/- for every field, and the notice says the stipend shall be paid as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as Amended). During the apprenticeship, candidates are governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the policies and rules of the organization. Canteen facilities will be available on a chargeable basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made on the National Web Portal, https://nats.education.gov.in . The notice gives these steps for students who have not yet enrolled on the portal. Go to https://nats.education.gov.in . Click Student, then Student Register. Complete the application form. A unique Enrolment Number is generated for each student. After enrolment, login on Student. Search "Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad" under Apply against advertised vacancies. Click Apply. The portal then shows that you have successfully applied for the vacancy. Enter the percentage of marks obtained in B.Tech in the column "% of marks / CGPA" on the NATS portal. This is mandatory, and candidature will not be considered if it is not furnished. Applications received after 30/11/2026 will not be considered. For information or queries, write to [email protected] ; the notice says no other medium of communication will be entertained. For queries on student enrolment on the web portal, the notice gives natssupport_student@aicte_india.org.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the merit of the percentage of marks obtained in the written test conducted by BEL Ghaziabad. Candidates are first shortlisted for the written test on the final percentage of marks obtained in their B.Tech. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the written test through their registered e-mail ID. The notice gives no test date, pattern or syllabus, and mentions no interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates who fulfil all the eligibility criteria may apply. BEL Ghaziabad has no obligation to give regular employment to apprentices, who have no right to claim regular employment on the basis of this apprenticeship. The Management's decision is final and binding on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and cancellation of the selection process, and no correspondence will be entertained. If some seats are not filled due to unsuitability or an insufficient number of candidates, filling them is at the Management's discretion and no claim will arise for engagement. BEL Ghaziabad does not take responsibility for non-selection or non-issuance of a call or offer letter.

faq.question: Q1. How many Graduate Apprentice vacancies are there in BEL Ghaziabad?
faq.answer: There are 15 proposed places for 2026-27: Civil Engineering 2, Mechanical Engineering 3 and Electronics 10. The number is indicative and may be changed by the Management.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEL Graduate Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications opened on 15 November 2026, and those received after 30/11/2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech in the advertised branches, recognized by AICTE or GOI, passed on or after 14/11/2023. Only Indian Nationals can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Maximum age should not be more than 25 years as on 15/11/2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwBD.

faq.question: Q5. How much is the stipend?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is INR 17,500/- for all three fields, paid as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as Amended).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Enrol as a student on https://nats.education.gov.in, login, search "Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad" under Apply against advertised vacancies and click Apply.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on their final B.Tech percentage, then selected on the merit of the percentage of marks in the written test conducted by BEL Ghaziabad.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a one-year apprenticeship, and BEL Ghaziabad has no obligation to give regular employment to apprentices.

faq.question: Q9. Can someone who has already done an apprenticeship apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who completed or terminated an apprenticeship mid-way, or are pursuing one with another organization, are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Is entering B.Tech percentage compulsory on the portal?
faq.answer: Yes. The percentage must be entered in the "% of marks / CGPA" column on the NATS portal, or the candidature will not be considered.
